questionAnswered: What evidence is needed before the 4K QA recognizability cues can become evidence-backed facade/corridor cues?

cueEligibilityCriteria.eligibleState: eligible_for_batu_review_when_repo_local_or_future_approved_evidence_shows corner composition from more than one relevant view or one unambiguous corner view without exact frontage claims
cueEligibilityCriteria.insufficientState: insufficient_when only scaffold lineage or generic corner-wrap candidate exists
cueEligibilityCriteria.blockedState: blocked_when evidence would require exact storefront, tenant, sign, entrance, active-status, restricted-source, or unapproved external-source claims

cueEligibilityCriteria.eligibleState: eligible_for_batu_review_when evidence shows sidewalk or street-edge grounding as a review cue without exact curb, entrance, or fixture placement claims
cueEligibilityCriteria.insufficientState: insufficient_when cue is only inferred from scaffold side or corridor guide geometry
cueEligibilityCriteria.blockedState: blocked_when evidence would imply exact sidewalk geometry, exact fixture placement, normal-mode readiness, or source use beyond approved review scope

cueEligibilityCriteria.eligibleState: eligible_for_batu_review_when evidence distinguishes a generic subway or street-furniture cue from surrounding sidewalk context without exact entrance or ownership claims

cueEligibilityCriteria.eligibleState: eligible_for_batu_review_when evidence supports broad depth, setback, or silhouette relationships without exact height, roof, or survey-grade geometry claims

cueEligibilityCriteria.eligibleState: eligible_for_batu_review_when evidence supports coarse frontage density or bay rhythm as a review cue without exact storefront count, order, width, or tenant assignment

reviewGateDecision.reason: 4K has useful QA recognizability cues, but approved evidence is endpoint-biased and insufficient for mid-corridor, cue-specific, distinct evidence-backed facade/corridor rendering.
missingEvidenceBatuWouldNeedToSupplyOrAp: depth_or_setback_reference_for_cues_that would affect silhouette or streetwall depth
material_color_reference_for_each cue intended to leave generic palette status
subway_or_entrance_reference_if any subway/entrance cue should remain visible
distinct_review_record_per facade/cue target so one evidence item is not overextended
